title: Rogers' book We Got It From Them

tellings.quote: >> Um to be really ingenious, I decided to call it We Got It From Them. [laughter]

plain: Greg Rogers, a doctor who has worked with NASA and says he saw a UFO in a secret hangar, says he wrote a book in 2025 about what he witnessed. He tells it in connection with Contact in the Desert, a UFO gathering, and jokes that, "to be really ingenious," he called it We Got It From Them, meaning the technology came from non-human makers.
